title: Mary Magdalene lands at Marseille; Merovingian bloodline
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Mary Magdalene lands at Marseille; Merovingian bloodline, about 1st century AD at Marseille, France, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Now, Mary Magdalene, according to some traditions, did travel with Joseph of Arythea, and she disembarked at the place that is now Marseilles.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson says on Jesse Michels's podcast that, according to some traditions, Mary Magdalene, a follower of Jesus, travelled with Joseph of Arimathea, another figure from the Gospels, and came ashore at the place that is now Marseille in France. The story is tied to the Merovingians, an early line of Frankish kings, and to the idea of a bloodline that would link them back to her.
